decisions.reason: The Magento 2 template was publicly recommended and costs little to maintain, so management keeps it even though it has not been visible since 2018.
The responsive template complements the hosting platform at low upkeep, and its fading visibility is read as a temporary lull rather than a reason to drop it.
Premium support embodies the firm's announced agency-focused, round-the-clock expert service direction, so commitment to it stays strong.
The version management tool reflects in-house development investment and had a dedicated page, so sunk costs and visible commitment favor persisting with it.
Although distant from the core, the multi-model data processing contract tool had its own page and ongoing GDPR demand, so weak results are attributed to temporary causes.
Scalable agency hosting is the announced flagship of the firm's direction and is shown on the home page, making it central and highly committed.
